title: rerank-seedset-and-slice-strategy-briefing-2026
summary: Notes and concrete proposal for generating a compact but representative seedset for reranker onboarding. Focus: pragmatic pairwise labeling protocol, stratified sampling quotas, ndcg baselines, and lightweight slicing to catch regressions early.
motivation: Current onboarding runs use large random samples which are expensive and miss rare failure modes. We need a small high-signal seedset (5k-15k examples) that: controls for intent distribution, surface-level difficulty, click-depth differences, and domain novelty. This doc proposes sampling rules + annotation schema + initial pilot observations.
seedset_generation: Principles: 1) stratify on intent (informational, navigational, transactional, conversational), 2) enforce length buckets for queries and candidates, 3) force a 20% slice of cold domains (low training density), 4) include synthetic paraphrase clusters for robustness, 5) prioritize queries with divergent baseline ranks across models. Implementation: sample 10k queries -> for each, sample top-10 candidates from baseline model A and top-10 from candidate model B -> dedupe -> collapse to rerank tasks of 6 candidates average. Target final: ~12k pairwise judgments (approx 70k pair comparisons).
sampling_quota_table:
Quota draft (target=12k pairs):
- intent: informational 40%, transactional 25%, navigational 20%, conversational 15%
- query-length: short (<3 tokens) 30%, medium (3-7) 50%, long (>7) 20%
- domain novelty: warm 80%, cold 20%
- click-depth: first-page hits 70%, deep-clicks 30%
Notes: quotas are soft; sampling is two-stage (query stratification then candidate diversification).
annotation_instructions: Pairwise preference task: show annotator a query + two candidate results (title+snippet). Ask: 'Which result would you click or find more relevant to the query?' Options: A, B, No Preference, Both Bad. Guidelines: prefer direct answer to informational, and conversion relevance for transactional. Spotlight shallow heuristics (spam, duplicate, wrong entity). Include examples for ambiguity and edge cases. Time per label target: 12-18s. Gold set: 500 seed pairs with consensus >=3/3.
pairwise_label_schema: Labels allowed: A (prefers A), B (prefers B), Tie/NoPreference, BothBad, Flag: Unsafe. Metadata per pair (collected offline): candidate lengths, model-origin tags, baseline-rank-diff. For evaluation we collapse Tie into 0.5 split for ndcg ranking simulations and BothBad treated as lowest relevance.
pairwise_task_ui_notes: UI: two-column A/B, highlight query tokens present in snippet, show source model tag, optional 'why' text box for conflict cases. Quality controls: hidden golds (from gold set), attention checks, and time floor. Compensation baseline aligned with previous pilots (target labeling throughput 180-300 pairs/hr per annotator).
ndcg_computation_details: We compute ndcg@k on inferred relevance scores from pairwise labels by converting pairwise wins into cardinal scores using Bradley-Terry scaling (fast approx) and also simple aggregation buckets: Relevant (1), Partially (0.5), Not (0). Report ndcg@1, @3, @5, and mean reciprocal rank (MRR) for intact comparability. Use bootstrap CI at 1000 resamples. Regression detection threshold: delta ndcg@3 < -0.003 flagged for immediate look. Reference: internal stat notebook (repo link in linked_artifacts).
slicing_plan: Slicing dims (priority order): 1) intent 2) domain novelty 3) query ambiguity (annotator disagreement > 20%) 4) candidate-length mismatch (long snippet vs short) 5) presence of numbers/entities. For each slice we compute per-slice ndcg and pairwise win rates. Alerting: any slice with >1% absolute drop in ndcg@3 vs baseline triggers auto-issue creation (ticket template noted in linked_artifacts).
pilot_observations: Pilot (1.2k pairs) run summary: average annotator agreement 0.78 (Krippendorff alpha ~0.62). Synthetic paraphrase cluster examples increased disagreement but uncovered 2 recurrent failure modes: 1) model over-preferences for copy-and-paste snippets (high lexical overlap but lower answer density) 2) entity hallucination in long snippets. Quick wins: add 'answer density' derived feature to slice monitor and expand cold-domain sampling to 30% for next round.
action_items: 1) finalize gold set (Priya + Ethan) by 2026-03-05. 2) Implement parity UI changes in eval tool (Omar) - ETA 2 weeks. 3) Run full seedset generation job (12k pairs) once gold set done. 4) Add automatic slice alerting hook to evaluation pipeline (JIRA:RINF-1287). 5) Draft short doc for solutions-eng about what slices mean for customers.
appendix_prompts:
Representative query examples used in pilot: 
- 'how to reset my router' (transactional, short)
- 'best running shoes for marathon training' (informational, long)
- 'github redwood inference api' (navigational)
- synthetic paraphrase cluster: 'reset wifi modem' / 'factory reset router' / 'restore router default settings'
Annotation edge case notes: when both candidates present partially complementary info prefer the one that answers the core intent.
notes_to_self: Follow-on: explore active learning seed selection (uncertainty + diversity), consider pairwise-to-list conversion experiments, measure correlation between pairwise-derived ndcg and click-simulated offline metrics.
